title: Degradation of IRF6 by TRIM59 in tumor cells triggers PGM1-mediated glycolysis to regulate cell proliferation in neuroblastoma.
authors: Zeng, Liang; Xu, Hui; Li, Meng; Qin, Liang-Jun; Chen, Kai; Wang, Feng-Hua; Li, Xiaomin; Yang, Tianyou; Miao, Lei; Wang, Hai-Yun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究IRF6通过转录调控PGM1影响神经母细胞瘤糖酵解，虽涉及TF-DNA转录调控（ChIP/双荧光素酶）但核心是肿瘤代谢与增殖，无AI/物理模拟方法，仅机器学习筛选基因，与TF-DNA互作建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: Neuroblastoma is the most common extracranial malignancy in children, and patients who develop recurrent or metastatic disease are likely to have a much poorer survival prognosis. Herein, by applying random forest and XGBoost machine-learning techniques, we identified interferon regulatory factor (IRF) 6 as the most crucial gene associated with neuroblastoma patient survival. Low IRF6 expression was further determined to be associated with dismal survival in neuroblastoma patients. IRF6 overexpression inhibited cell proliferation in vitro and in vivo and even weakened glycolytic metabolism and increased maximal respiration in SK-N-BE2 and CHP-212 cells. Mechanistically, RNA sequencing, ChIP, and dual-luciferase reporter assays revealed that IRF6 inhibited PGM1 expression by decreasing the transcriptional activity of promoter 3 of PGM1, and PGM1 overexpression may reverse the inhibitory effects of IRF6 on cell proliferation and glycolysis. Additionally, IRF6 expression was diminished in neuroblastoma due to E3 ligase TRIM59-mediated polyubiquitination, and may reverse the promoting effect of TRIM59 overexpression on cell proliferation and glycolysis. Our work thus provides mechanistic insight into the control of glycolysis-mediated disease progression and opens new avenues for developing therapeutic strategies in neuroblastoma.
abstract_zh: 神经母细胞瘤是儿童中最常见的颅外恶性肿瘤，复发或转移性疾病患者的生存预后可能显著较差。在此，通过应用随机森林和XGBoost机器学习技术，我们确定了干扰素调节因子（IRF）6为与神经母细胞瘤患者生存最相关的关键基因。进一步确定低IRF6表达与神经母细胞瘤患者的不良生存相关。IRF6过表达在体外和体内抑制细胞增殖，甚至在SK-N-BE2和CHP-212细胞中减弱糖酵解代谢并增加最大呼吸能力。机制上，RNA测序、ChIP和双荧光素酶报告基因实验揭示，IRF6通过降低PGM1启动子3的转录活性来抑制PGM1表达，而PGM1过表达可能逆转IRF6对细胞增殖和糖酵解的抑制作用。此外，由于E3连接酶TRIM59介导的多聚泛素化，IRF6在神经母细胞瘤中表达减少，并且可能逆转TRIM59过表达对细胞增殖和糖酵解的促进作用。因此，我们的工作为控制糖酵解介导的疾病进展提供了机制性见解，并为开发神经母细胞瘤治疗策略开辟了新途径。
